text:
laura: Heads-up: opened PR with a small docs appendix + SDK snippets for compact/strict schema migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1420. TL;DR: examples for compact-schema, strict-jsonschema, and a tiny client validation example.
ci-bot: build queued :hourglass: preview when ready: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1420
jon: Nice. Can we add a short note about how compact-schema trades validation for token savings? A one-liner is enough.
laura: Added a short paragraph under 'Choosing a schema format'. Also added a short checklist for migrations (backup prompts, run evals, enable linter).
priya: Request: include a tiny snippet showing how the SDK surfaces schema parse errors vs runtime tool errors. People often conflate them. Example suggestion: ```js
const resp = await client.call({ input, schema });
if (resp.error && resp.error.type === 'schema_parse') {
  console.warn('schema parse:', resp.error.message);
} else if (resp.error) {
  throw resp.error;
}
```
laura: Good call, adding that.
sameer: Also mention parser behavior for empty-string vs null for missing optional fields. Our parsers will drop empty-string -> undefined in some language bindings. Worth a note in migration gotchas.
priya: Can we add CI lint that rejects `items: { type: ['string','null'] }` style? Recommend `anyOf` union instead. I can prototype a docs-linter rule and a GitHub action.
jon: I like that. Docs-linter could also point to the canonical runtime examples folder. Saves reviewers time.
ci-bot: preview ready :white_check_mark: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1420?v=1
laura: Pushed linter TODO mention and a link to a prototype GH action in the PR description.
priya: I'll follow up with a tiny action in a separate PR for docs infra.
sameer: Quick schema nit: for nullable object arrays prefer `items: { anyOf: [ {type: 'object'}, {type: 'null'} ] }` rather than `type: ['object','null']` for consistent validator behavior. I'll add a one-line note.
laura: Thanks — incorporated sameer's note and added a migration checklist entry: "run downstream parsers on a sample corpus".
jon: Minor: one broken link in the appendix -> /docs/functions/calling. Should be /docs/tool-calling.
laura: Fixed link and rebased. Will merge after CI stays green. If anyone wants to add a short example to the SDK snippet (stream fallback or error shape) push to the branch.
priya: Adding a 1-line streaming fallback to the SDK snippet in a follow-up commit.
laura: Great, merging in ~10 mins if no objections. Thanks!
